definitions: A very tall African ruminant mammal with a long neck and legs, a yellowish-brown coat spotted with darker patches, and two short, skin-covered horns.
A constellation in the northern sky, also known as Camelopardalis.
examples: The giraffe stretched its long neck to reach the highest leaves.
We saw a herd of giraffes at the waterhole.
The constellation Giraffe is visible in the winter sky.
